subject: Intro call recap & proposed next steps — SequoiaHealth
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Ava Miller <ava@sequoiahealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Intro call recap & proposed next steps — SequoiaHealth

Hi Ava — great to meet virtually today. Quick recap from our 30-minute intro and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Summary of notes:
- Current pain: inconsistent inference latency on long patient notes, high token cost for nightly indexing jobs, and no reliable A/B testing setup for new prompts.
- Primary use cases discussed: in-product summaries for clinicians, search ranking improvements, and a pilot for anonymized embeddings for research queries.
- Stakeholders you mentioned: CTO (Mark), CPO (Lina), and procurement (procurement@sequoiahealth.com).

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive (45–60m) with engineering (we'll bring a runtime engineer + solutions lead) — goal: confirm latency/throughput SLO and integration pattern.
2) Draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for pilot scope, timeline, and success metrics.
3) Budget/approval checkpoint — confirm procurement timeline and any compliance requirements (SOC2, VPC).

Availability: I can do the deep dive next week (Tue/Wed morning PT). Vanessa (cc) can join for procurement/contract questions.

Attachments: I can send a one-page MAP and a ballpark cost estimate before the deep dive if helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Ava Miller <ava@sequoiahealth.com>, procurement@sequoiahealth.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + EoQ timing check — SequoiaHealth pilot

Hi Ava / procurement team — following up with the MAP attached (SequoiaHealth-MAP-v1.pdf). Quick note: we’re approaching the end of our quarter (June 30) and I want to make sure we’re aligned on timing. A couple of things I want to surface so we can avoid last-minute blockers:

- Is the pilot still a priority to start this quarter? If budget/approval needs to close before June 30 to hit Q2 procurement cycles, we can prioritize a condensed SOW and procurement packet.
- If approvals are likely to slip, what is your best estimate for when procurement would be ready? (mid-July / early-Aug / later)
- Any compliance or security evidence you need up front? We can deliver SOC 2 docs, KMS details, and a short network diagram quickly.

Proposed immediate options:
A) If approvals are on track: quick technical deep-dive + redlineable SOW this week, target sign-off before 6/30.
B) If timing has shifted: schedule a 15m sync to document the new timeline and prioritize kickoff for the next quarter.

I’ve included our HubSpot deal link for reference (HS-88421). Attachment: SequoiaHealth-MAP-v1.pdf (pilot scope + milestones).

Appreciate any update — if easier, a one-line reply is perfect.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

(Attachment: SequoiaHealth-MAP-v1.pdf)

From: Ava Miller <ava@sequoiahealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sequoiahealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + EoQ timing check — SequoiaHealth pilot

Thanks for the nudge, Dylan — sorry for the delay. Quick update from our side: 

- Priority shift: CFO has instituted a temporary freeze on new third-party cloud contracts while we finalize our FY26 budget. That pause affects any new pilot spend through July.
- Effect on timing: best estimate is that procurement will reopen conversations in mid-August once the finance review completes.
- Compliance: we did download the MAP and SOC2 note looks fine — procurement will ask for a standard vendor questionnaire when we restart.

procurement@sequoiahealth.com is on cc to ensure they're looped. For now, please mark this as "postponed — revisit mid-Aug" on your side. We remain interested in the use cases discussed, particularly the clinician summaries, but the timing slipped because of the broader budget review.

Would appreciate if you could send a short one-page pilot summary we can attach to the procurement packet (we’ll need that to brief the finance team). If you can get that to us by next Wednesday, I’ll make sure it’s routed to the right reviewers.

Best,
Ava Miller
Head of Product — Clinical Tools | SequoiaHealth
ava@sequoiahealth.com
